_doc: I/L Arch Mage line (spec #319, I12 #331). All twelve pool skills are defined; I/L is playable and F/P (212) remains the default.

222._starting_skill: tier C: spec #319 D2: every round starts with Cold Beam in active slot 1.
222._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #319 R4: Teleport (2201002) is I/L's manual mobility skill on the skill key, outside both slot tracks; its data moves into this line with I6.
222._skill_pool: tier C: spec #319: the twelve auto-cast actives of the 200/220/221/222 books. Energy Bolt and Magic Claw are F/P's own definitions (one set of data, no copies).
222._weapon_families: tier C: spec #319: the wand and staff families, as F/P; the Magician armour drops by the class bit.
222._creation_weapon: tier C: spec #319: the same Wooden Wand as F/P; wearing it needs only the Magician class bit (reqJob, no level requirement).
222._provenance: tier C: spec #319 (I2 #321): I12 #331 enables I/L after the skill and tooling tickets; F/P stays the default.
